accepted_guarantees: platform-owned durable append-only partition channels with ObjectRef payload authority
per-consumer in-flight ownership and cursor advancement only after a durable terminal yield or return
periodic coordinator barriers for checkpoint-managed state and aligned multi-input cuts, separate from each per-turn handoff
bounded retained replay horizons, branch-local recovery, backpressure credits, exact retry identities and named horizon refusal
selected PostgreSQL release/session migration and signed schema-restore cutover with fail-closed stale authority
actual Prefect long-lived source/operator tasks, failed-operator-only retry, control lifecycle and independent authority projections without Prefect core changes
client_responsibility: Workflow code must remain deterministic for replay and idempotent for arbitrary external effects.

documentation_graph.note: The graph is rerun after linking this review; the path and pass/counts are authoritative rather than a pre-link file hash.

limits: This is an experimental prototype acceptance, not a production deployment or general Prefect feature claim.
Arbitrary external effects belong to client determinism and idempotency; the platform does not make them atomically exactly-once.
Capacity is measured only for the declared short one-source/two-branch workload and is not a production throughput, disk, WAL-retention or multi-tenant SLO.

The selected closed-network operator boundary trusts the host kernel, container runtime, platform daemon, PostgreSQL role design and direct database credential boundary; general connectors and hostile-kernel isolation remain unsupported.
Backup evidence is schema-scoped with an explicit recovery point, not whole-cluster recovery or zero RPO.
Missing durable payload beyond the retained horizon and non-rewindable external sources fail at an explicit unrecoverable boundary; bytes are not regenerated implicitly.
The physical HA campaign supports the storage/data-plane layer and does not by itself prove every release/session guard during failover.
The separate 72-hour DS-052a campaign is queued but has not started; no long-soak PASS is claimed.
name: streaming_etl_short_experimental_delivery_architecture_review
terminal_progress_rule: For the accepted v2 scope, one durably observed terminal yield or return commits managed state/output witnesses and advances the input cursor.
